headline: Mets’ Comeback Falls Short in 15-14 Loss to Mighty Mussels
teaser: Randy Guzman hit two home runs and drove in six as the St. Lucie Mets nearly erased an eight-run deficit in a 15-14 loss to Fort Myers.
body:
The St. Lucie Mets nearly erased an eight-run first-inning deficit but fell one run short in a 15-14 loss to the Fort Myers Mighty Mussels on Saturday night at Clover Park.

Fort Myers scored eight runs in the opening inning and survived several St. Lucie rallies to earn its third consecutive victory.

Mets starter Ethan Lanthier was charged with seven runs on five hits and two walks before being removed with two outs in the first inning. Harry Genth delivered a three-run double during the Mussels' early outburst.

## Mets Answer With Five-Run First Inning

St. Lucie immediately responded with five runs against Fort Myers starter Matt Barr in the bottom of the first. Antonio Jimenez, Branny De Oleo and Simon Juan each recorded RBI hits to cut the deficit to 8-5.

The Mighty Mussels added three runs against Franyel Diaz in the third inning. Ramiro Dominguez drove in two with a single, and Byron Chourio hit a solo home run to extend the Fort Myers lead to 11-5.

Trey Snyder helped St. Lucie pull closer in the fourth inning with an unconventional trip around the bases. Snyder's ground-ball single was mishandled by shortstop Quetin Young, who then committed a throwing error that allowed Snyder to score and another run to cross the plate.

The play cut the Mussels' lead to 11-7.

## Guzman Homers Twice

Randy Guzman hit a two-run homer against Ramiro Villanueva in the fifth inning to bring the Mets within two runs.

Villanueva later hit consecutive batters and was ejected. St. Lucie loaded the bases with one out, but reliever Adam Falinski retired Elian Pena on a popout and Snyder on a groundout to preserve the 11-9 Fort Myers advantage.

Young answered with a three-run home run over the batter's eye in the sixth, pushing the Mussels' lead to 14-9.

Guzman responded again in the bottom half of the inning, launching a three-run homer to make it 14-12.

He finished the game 3-for-4 with two home runs, a single, six RBIs and two runs scored.

## Ninth-Inning Rally Falls One Run Short

Ricardo Paez opened the ninth inning with a solo home run that gave Fort Myers a 15-13 lead and provided what proved to be a crucial insurance run.

Francisco Toledo scored on a wild pitch and throwing error with one out in the bottom of the ninth. Marco Vargas then homered to right field with two outs, pulling St. Lucie within one run at 15-14.

Brent Francisco struck out Chase Meggers to end the game and record his third save.

Michael Hilker Jr. earned the win after pitching 2 1/3 scoreless innings of relief for Fort Myers. Lanthier took the loss.

Jimenez went 2-for-3 with two walks and three runs scored. Vargas, De Oleo and Juan added two hits apiece.

The Mets fell to 10-18 in the second half and 43-51 overall. The Mighty Mussels improved to 14-14 in the second half and 51-42 overall.

The teams will conclude their series Sunday at Clover Park. First pitch is scheduled for 12:10 p.m.

headline: Hurricane Season Ready: 12 Treasure Coast Essentials to Stock Up On
teaser: From weather alerts and backup power to water storage, lighting and first aid, these 12 practical products can help fill common gaps in a Treasure Coast hurricane kit.
affiliate_disclosure: Treasure Coast Today may earn a commission from qualifying purchases made through links in this article. Prices, product details and availability may change.
intro:
Hurricane preparation on the Treasure Coast works best when it happens before a storm enters the forecast cone. Even a relatively short outage can mean dark rooms, dead phones, limited internet access and no easy way to open shelf-stable food. A longer disruption can make stored water, backup charging, cooling and basic repair supplies much more important.

The 12 products below cover common gaps in a household hurricane kit: official weather information, portable power, lighting, water storage and filtration, first aid, food access and post-storm cleanup. These are researched products to consider, not items we claim to have personally tested. Match capacity and compatibility to your household, follow official evacuation instructions and never risk personal safety to protect property.

products.name: Jackery Explorer 300 Portable Power Station
products.label: Best for Backup Power
products.summary: A compact power station can keep phones, rechargeable lights, a router and other small electronics running when household power is unavailable. The Jackery Explorer 300 has a 293Wh battery and a 300W pure-sine-wave inverter, so it is designed for lower-wattage essentials rather than large appliances or whole-home backup.
why_we_chose_it: Charges or powers up to six compatible devices at once
Includes AC, USB-C, USB-A and vehicle-style outputs
Can recharge from a wall outlet, vehicle connection or compatible solar panel
products.best_for: Phones, lights, internet equipment and other small essentials

products.name: Midland Emergency Weather Radio
products.label: Best for Weather Alerts
products.summary: A dedicated weather radio gives your household another way to receive urgent information when internet service, television or cellular networks are unreliable. Midland emergency radios combine NOAA weather reception with alternate power options and emergency lighting, making one a practical centerpiece for a storm kit.
why_we_chose_it: Receives NOAA weather information and emergency alerts
Multiple charging options help during extended outages
Built-in flashlight and emergency signaling features
products.best_for: Receiving official weather information during outages
products.image_alt: Midland emergency weather radio with antenna

products.name: GearLight LED Flashlights
products.label: Best Flashlight Set
products.summary: Flashlights remain useful even when lanterns are available because they provide a focused beam for checking a breaker panel, walking outside after the storm or inspecting a dark room. GearLight's compact tactical-style flashlights offer multiple modes and an adjustable beam in a size that is easy to distribute around the house.
why_we_chose_it: Adjustable beam for wide-area or focused lighting
Multiple light modes for routine and emergency use
Compact enough to keep in bedrooms, vehicles and go-bags

products.name: Collapsible LED Lantern
products.label: Best for Room Lighting
products.summary: A lantern spreads light through a room more effectively than a handheld flashlight. The collapsible design is especially convenient for hurricane kits because it stores compactly, then expands when you need area lighting in a kitchen, bathroom or central living space.
why_we_chose_it: Provides broad area lighting rather than a narrow beam
Collapsible body saves space between storm seasons
Carry handles make it easy to move or hang where needed
products.best_for: Lighting shared rooms during a power outage

products.name: Coozment Collapsible Water Container
products.label: Best for Water Storage
products.summary: Stored water should be part of the plan before a storm approaches, especially if a prolonged outage affects pumps, treatment systems or normal shopping. A collapsible container provides dedicated water storage without taking up the same amount of room when it is empty. Clean and sanitize it according to the manufacturer's directions before filling.
why_we_chose_it: Collapses for easier off-season storage
Dedicated container helps separate drinking water from utility water
Designed for easier carrying and controlled dispensing
products.best_for: Filling with potable water before storm conditions arrive

products.name: KitchenAid Manual Can Opener
products.label: Best No-Power Kitchen Tool
products.summary: Shelf-stable food is only helpful when you can open it. A dependable manual can opener belongs in the same bin as canned meals, beans, fruit and pet food because it works without electricity and takes almost no storage space. KitchenAid's classic design uses comfortable handles and a large turning knob for a secure grip.
why_we_chose_it: Works without batteries or household power
Large turning knob and easy-grip handles
Small enough to keep permanently inside the food-supply bin
products.best_for: Opening shelf-stable food during an outage

products.name: LifeStraw Personal Water Filter
products.label: Best Backup Water Filter
products.summary: LifeStraw is a compact backup option when a safe water source is uncertain. Its membrane filter is designed to remove bacteria, parasites, microplastics, dirt and cloudiness, and the filter is rated for up to 1,000 gallons. It should supplement—not replace—stored drinking water, and the personal model does not remove viruses or every chemical contaminant.
why_we_chose_it: Lightweight and easy to store in a household or evacuation kit
Filters bacteria, parasites and microplastics from freshwater
No batteries or charging required
products.best_for: Emergency backup filtration from appropriate freshwater sources

products.name: MaiVoz Portable Power Bank
products.label: Best for Phone Charging
products.summary: A high-capacity power bank is easier to carry than a power station and can be reserved specifically for phones, tablets, earbuds and other USB devices. The MaiVoz model is listed with a 56,800mAh capacity, 22.5W fast charging and multiple outputs, giving a household a portable charging option for an evacuation or a room without power.
why_we_chose_it: High listed capacity for repeated mobile-device charging
USB-A and USB-C connections for multiple device types
Digital display makes remaining charge easier to monitor
products.best_for: Keeping phones and small USB devices charged

products.name: Renogy Portable Solar Panel
products.label: Best for Extended Outages
products.summary: A portable solar panel can extend the usefulness of a compatible power station when utility restoration takes longer than expected. Renogy's foldable panels are designed for portable charging, but buyers should verify voltage, connector type and input limits before pairing a panel with any battery or power station. Output will also vary with sun angle, clouds and heat.
why_we_chose_it: Foldable design is easier to store and position outdoors
Can support daytime recharging of compatible battery systems
Useful beyond hurricane season for camping and off-grid needs
products.best_for: Recharging compatible portable power equipment in sunlight

products.name: BAND-AID Brand All-Purpose First Aid Kit
products.label: Best for Minor Injuries
products.summary: Storm preparation and cleanup can lead to small cuts, scrapes, burns and insect bites. An organized first aid kit keeps bandages, gauze, cleansing supplies and basic treatments together instead of scattered across several cabinets. This type of all-purpose kit is a useful starting point, but households should add prescriptions, allergy medication and any supplies specific to family members.
why_we_chose_it: Organized supplies for common minor injuries
Portable case can move with an evacuation kit
Easy foundation for a household-specific medical kit
products.best_for: Minor cuts, scrapes and routine first aid
products.image_alt: BAND-AID Brand all-purpose first aid kit

products.name: Amazon Basics Weatherproof Multipurpose Tarp
products.label: Best Storm-Cleanup Utility
products.summary: A weather-resistant tarp can cover supplies, protect a vehicle interior, create temporary shade or help limit additional rain exposure after minor property damage. Amazon Basics tarps use laminated polyethylene material with reinforced edges and tie-down points. A tarp is only a temporary measure—never climb onto a wet or storm-damaged roof or use one as a substitute for professional repairs.
why_we_chose_it: Useful for temporary coverage and protecting stored supplies
Reinforced edges and grommets support secure tie-downs
Folds relatively flat for garage or hurricane-bin storage
products.best_for: Temporary protection during cleanup and recovery
products.price_note: Choose the needed size and check current price

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX Cordless Jobsite Fan
products.label: Best for Battery-Powered Cooling
products.summary: Florida homes can become uncomfortable quickly when air conditioning is unavailable. DEWALT's cordless jobsite fan provides adjustable, portable airflow and is especially practical for households that already own compatible 20V MAX batteries. Many listings are tool-only, so confirm whether a battery and charger are included before ordering.
why_we_chose_it: Variable-speed airflow for different rooms and conditions
Adjustable frame supports floor, table or mounted positioning
Uses the widely available DEWALT 20V MAX battery platform
products.best_for: Targeted airflow during outages and cleanup
products.price_note: Battery may be sold separately; check current price

closing:
The best hurricane kit is the one assembled before shelves empty and delivery windows disappear. Charge every battery, test the radio and lights, sanitize water containers, check first aid expiration dates and keep the entire kit where everyone in the household can find it.

No collection of products replaces a family communication plan, an evacuation route or guidance from local emergency officials. Think of these items as practical support for the hours and days when normal utilities and routines are interrupted.

headline: Port St. Lucie Police Unveil New $28 Million Training Facility
teaser: The 54,283-square-foot facility includes an indoor firearms range, tactical shoot house, virtual simulation theater and dedicated training spaces for Port St. Lucie police.
body:
The Port St. Lucie Police Department has unveiled a new $28 million training facility designed to provide officers with updated technology and specialized spaces for law enforcement instruction.

The department held a ribbon-cutting ceremony Friday, giving members of the media a first look inside the 54,283-square-foot building before it becomes operational.

## Facility includes range, tactical and simulation training

The new facility includes a 20-lane indoor firearms range and a tactical shoot house where officers can participate in scenario-based exercises.

A MILO virtual simulation theater will be used for decision-making and de-escalation training, while a defensive tactics room is equipped with Axon virtual reality technology.

The building also features a multi-purpose training room, updated audio and visual systems, and office space for the department's Training Division and Criminal Investigations Division.

## Police cite city's continued growth

Port St. Lucie police said the facility was developed to support the department's continuing training needs as the city grows.

The project was designed by ADG Architecture and constructed by HJ High. Specialized equipment and technology were provided by companies including Action Target, MILO and Whelen.

Department personnel are expected to begin moving into the building Saturday, July 25.

Police said the secure training facility will not be open to the public.
